race.comment: ABENDER (2) tackles an easier assignment and should be hitting his straps fourth-up over a trip he relishes. The form around him reads favourably and the low draw should give him a great look. KEEP IT REAL (8) brings a different profile. He was held up when beaten a nose two back, then had late interference at Gold Coast. First-time blinkers could give him a genuine spark third-up. SHORTCUT (10) took on tougher company last campaign, so she should get a pleasant surprise when walking around the mounting yard. Has been fitted with two trials and can play a major role fresh. DISCREET POINT (9) was okay when a beaten fav at Ballina. Expecting more second-up.
